verdict.rationale: Runloop's Devboxes are documented as secure sandboxed execution environments with explicit mechanisms to keep secrets isolated from agent code: Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs 'without ever seeing your API keys', MCP Hub gives agents access to tool servers 'without exposing credentials', account secrets are encrypted at rest and injected only as env vars, and network egress can be controlled via network policies. This directly matches the story of isolating host credentials from agent-run code. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on security audits or third-party penetration testing corroborating these isolation claims beyond first-party docs.
